categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches ConnectBlock and ActivateBestChainStep in validation logic with the Validation label.
categories.rationale: Fixes inconsistent hybrid validation states and prevents duplicate fatal error notifications during disk flush and block corruption errors. As noted in the PR description, calling ValidationState::Error on an already-invalid or errored state preserved stale rejection metadata, and commit b4b95702bc removes a redundant, less-specific fatal error emission while unblocking refactoring in #35570.
